claim.claim-text: 1. A communication system comprising:
a network node and a wireless device transmitting synchronization signals; and a synchronization receiving device (800) comprising:

a synchronization reception unit (840) for receiving predetermined wireless synchronization signals from synchronization sources including a synchronization source which derives its synchronization signal from the network node and the wireless device; a synchronization source selection unit (860) for selecting a synchronization source from among the synchronization sources according to a metric, and a timing unit (870) for determining or adjusting the timing for transmission or reception of data according to the synchronization signal of the synchronization source selected by the synchronization source selection unit characterized by a metric acquisition unit (850) for determining the selection metric for each of the synchronization sources based on a combination of:
- quality of the received synchronization signal.

2. The synchronization receiving device (800) according to claim 1, wherein the metric acquisition unit is configured to determine the metric further based on a type of the synchronization source which is either a synchronization source which derives its synchronization signal from a network node or a network-independent wireless device.

3. The synchronization receiving device (800) according to claim 2, wherein the metric acquisition unit is configured to determine the selection bias according to an association between predetermined selection bias values and the respective numbers of hops.

4. The synchronization receiving device (800) according to claim 2, wherein the metric acquisition unit (850) is configured to determine the selection bias by receiving it within signaling information transmitted from the respective synchronization source.

5. The synchronization receiving device (800) according to claim 1, wherein the metric acquisition unit (850) is configured to determine the metric as a linear combination of the quality of the received synchronization signal; a number representing whether the synchronization source is a network node (710) or a wireless device; and the number of hops to a network node (710).
6. The synchronization receiving device (800) according to claim 5, wherein

the linear combination is defined as M = a*T + b*H + c*Q, with T being the source of synchronization, H being the number of hops and Q being the received signal quality; and a, b, and c being weighting factors. the metric acquisition unit (850) is configured to determine the weighting factors a, b, or c by receiving them within signaling information transmitted from the network node (710).
7. The synchronization receiving device (800) according to claim 1, wherein

the synchronization source selection unit (860) is configured to perform a pre-selection of synchronization sources by excluding from a set of candidate synchronization sources: - sources with the number of hops to the network node exceeding a predetermined hop threshold, and/or - sources with the signal quality not exceeding a predetermined quality threshold; and

the metric acquisition unit (850) is configured to determine the metric only for the synchronization sources in the set of candidate synchronization sources after the pre-selection performed by the synchronization source selection unit (860).
8. The synchronization receiving device (800) according to claim 1, further comprising

a reselection timer (885), and a selection control unit (880) for controlling the metric acquisition unit (850) to determine the metric and the synchronization source selection unit (860) to select the synchronization source in accordance with the reselection timer (885).

9. The synchronization receiving device (800) according to claim 8, further comprising a hysteresis timer (865) which starts upon selecting a new synchronization source and expires after a predetermined hysteresis period, wherein
the reselection timer (885) is set to a predetermined time period; the selection control unit (880) instructs:

the metric acquisition unit (850) to determine the metric and the synchronization source selection unit (860) to select the synchronization source according to the metric upon expiry of the reselection timer (885) if the hysteresis timer (865) expired and not to select the synchronization source according to the metric upon expiry of the reselection timer (885) it the hysteresis timer (865) did not expired.
10. The synchronization receiving device (800) according to claim 9, wherein the predetermined hysteresis period decreases with the number of reselection timer (885) expiries.
11. A synchronization receiving method comprising the steps of:
- quality of the received synchronization signal.

12. The synchronization receiving method according to claim 11, wherein the metric is determined as a linear combination of the quality of the received synchronization signal; a number representing whether the synchronization source is a network node or a wireless device; and the number of hops to a network node.

13. The synchronization receiving method according to claim 11 or 12, further comprising a step of pre-selecting (920) synchronization sources by excluding from a set of candidate synchronization sources:

- sources with the number of hops to the network node exceeding a predetermined hop threshold, and/or - sources with the signal quality not exceeding a predetermined quality threshold; and wherein the metric is determined only for the synchronization sources in the set of candidate synchronization sources after the pre-selection performed by the synchronization source selection unit.
14. The synchronization receiving method according to any of claims 11 to 13, further comprising
maintaining a reselection timer, and controlling the determining of the metric and the selecting of the synchronization source in accordance with the reselection timer.
